target_customer: Urology practices and clinicians who bill remote patient monitoring reimbursement
problem: Urinary conditions like UTIs and BPH flare ups are detected late; clinicians lack continuous urine data.
business_model: Device plus remote patient monitoring reimbursement revenue shared with clinicians

founders.name: Hannah McKenney
founders.background_notes: YC page: human factors and clinical implementation experience

founders.name: Drew Hendricks
founders.background_notes: YC page: background in medicine and device design; sources differ on first name

founders.name: Alex Arevalos
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder and CEO by TechCrunch 2023; not on YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Spectroscopy sensors in a toilet attachment plus AI models needed hardware and a clinical validation study with Stanford (TechCrunch 2023).

defensibility.rationale: FDA registration claim and clinical data are hard to replicate, though claim is company stated.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Withings showed U-Scan at CES in January 2023, a year after the batch.

market_need_then: Company cites a urinalysis market forecast of 4.9B by 2026 (TechCrunch 2023) and reimbursement for remote monitoring.

brand_strength.rationale: Starling collides with the UK Starling Bank in search; product name StarStream got TechCrunch coverage but no brand community found.

pivots.from: Catheter device for neurological bladder dysfunction (as DASH Innovations per search result)
pivots.why: Concept came during Winter 2022 YC batch (TechCrunch 2023)

outcome_analysis: Starling Medical pivoted during YC from a catheter device to StarStream, a toilet attached urine monitor, and announced a 3.4 million dollar seed led by Rebel Fund in January 2023 with a Stanford validation study behind it. It planned a first enterprise deployment with a large Texas urology practice. No later round or exit was verified, so it is early stage with promising clinical traction.
